summary: Cottle Knob lookout in Nicholas County: FFLOS and Eastern lookouts say removed; firelookout.org lists a standing tower at Pocahontas Co. H.S. as relocated.

facts.status_note: Sources conflict. FFLOS and the Eastern lookouts page say the tower was removed, while firelookout.org lists a standing tower at Pocahontas Co. H.S. coded as relocated from Cottle Knob (Standing*).

evidence.supports: Location in Nicholas County, West Virginia
FFLOS says the tower has been removed
The FFLOS register date for this entry
The Eastern lookouts page lists the West Virginia Division of Forestry as agency
The Eastern lookouts page gives the fate as Removed
The original Cottle Knob site is listed as gone

corrections.current: The lookout was moved to Pocahontas Co. H.S.
corrections.proposed: Disputed: FFLOS says the tower was removed; firelookout.org lists a relocated tower at Pocahontas Co. H.S.
corrections.why: The two register entries disagree and neither gives a date, so the move should not be stated as fact.
FFLOS and the Eastern lookouts page say removed; only firelookout.org says relocated, with no date. The record should not state a relocation as settled.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and the Eastern lookouts page say the tower was removed. firelookout.org says a standing tower was relocated to Pocahontas Co. H.S. No source found explains or dates a move, and no search result linked the school to a tower.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern lookouts Cottle page gives only the word Removed with no history. No build date, design, or staffing found in anything reachable. The 'moved to Pocahontas Co. H.S.' claim rests only on firelookout.org and conflicts with FFLOS. A WV Division of Forestry tower list PDF that a search surfaced (wvenc-f5.wvnet.edu) could not be fetched because the host does not resolve. Worth checking the school site or state records before publishing the relocation claim.
